arena_slots.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

arena_free_indices.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

leaf_arena_slots.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

leaf_arena_free_indices.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

arena_zero_queue.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

property_slots.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

dense_array_elements.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

array_buffer_bytes.basis: owned-inline-storage; excludes nested allocations and allocator overhead

string_nodes.basis: node-count-only; payloads are Rc-owned outside the arena accounting

bigint_nodes.basis: node-count-only; payloads are Rc-owned outside the arena accounting

exec_words.basis: deduplicated-Rc-slice-inline-bytes; includes extension words, excludes Rc headers

bytecode_property_keys.basis: linked-name-count; deduplicated map slice bytes including unused slots; excludes Rc headers and auxiliary atom references

bytecode_executable_projections.basis: one initialized shared projection per bytecode node; excludes Rc headers and shared slice payloads

strings.basis: unavailable: strings may be shared with atoms, bytecode and embedder values

owned_storage.basis: per-store-Vec-capacity-peaks-and-logical-owner-transfers; excludes bridge containers, cold payloads and primitive Rc events

call_buffers_scope: producer-local-successful-capacity-and-copy-observations; not total allocator or retain/release accounting
vm_phase_samples_basis: first-4096-attempts-per-phase; includes errors; [inclusive,exclusive] ns; child phases share one exclusive clock

call_preparation.basis: cumulative-capacities; argument-buffers-are-observations; excludes bound/apply scratch and total Runtime retains

execution_diagnostics.basis: logical-profiled-events; no timing; executed-functions-only except compiler_rejections; max 4096 functions, 16384 sites per category, 4 callee identities per callsite
execution_diagnostics.callsite_scope: ordinary-driver-enter-selected-only; other call and construct paths are excluded
